# SpikePhaseSeparationMechanism

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanism where feedback interactions cause the network to spontaneously partition into regions of distinct spike phases, analogous to phase separation in physical systems. This mechanism could enable modular, self-organizing computation in neuromorphic and topological computing, where different phases represent different computational states.
